headline: Claude Code gains traction as developers adopt agentic design system integration
body: Anthropic's Claude Code is seeing increased developer adoption, particularly for frontend refactoring tasks integrated with design systems and AI-powered tools like Figma MCP. This shift toward agentic AI in development workflows signals a broader move away from traditional code assistants toward systems that can autonomously manage design-to-code pipelines. For healthcare organizations, this matters because clinical UI systems require rapid iteration across EHR interfaces, patient portals, and care coordination tools. As development velocity increases through agentic assistance, healthcare vendors and IT teams can accelerate deployment of new clinical features while maintaining design consistency across complex workflows. Teams currently managing separate documentation and configuration files should evaluate whether consolidated agentic approaches could streamline their own healthcare application development cycles.
